name: create_user_tenant_scope_table
description: Create user_tenant_scope table for s5d member-scope assignment: per user-per-tenant-per-module JSON scope values. Keyed (email, administration, module) with FK to tenants(administration) and tenant-isolation indexes. MySQL 9.x: no IF (NOT) EXISTS on indexes.
up: CREATE TABLE user_tenant_scope (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, administration VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, module VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, scopes JSON NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by VARCHAR(255), UNIQUE KEY uk_user_tenant_scope (email, administration, module), INDEX idx_administration (administration), INDEX idx_admin_module (administration, module), FOREIGN KEY (administration) REFERENCES tenants(administration)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
